scope: Reference plus six sampled frames at0/1/2/3/4/5.125 seconds, not continuous audiovisual listening or human dance acceptance

observations.neutral_teacher: Staircase teacher retains yellow top/grey trousers, with visible steps, turning and arm extension. Red and shop teachers show changing bilateral arm gestures and weight/stance shifts. These sampled events are not certification of continuous usable dancing or song adherence.
observations.w256: Staircase changes to dark blue sportswear and small bag, mostly hand gestures and rear leg curl. Red changes toward hand-to-mouth/behind-head/raised-arm motif. Shop has mostly stationary limited arm motion. Projection changes visible control despite preserving source length and packed layout.
observations.ln255: Similar visible motif to W256; staircase sportswear changes persist, red face/head arm motif and low-amplitude shop arm changes remain. No meaningful improvement over W is established by sampled frames.
observations.pca256: Red and shop sampled arm/stance sequence is closer to the raw neutral teacher than W/LN. Staircase retains larger turn, step and arm extension but still drifts to white-blue sportswear/bag. Approximate PCA has not established identity preservation or usable music-controlled choreography.

limitations: W and PCA have different affine centers and directions; differences concern the complete learned output space, not only basis orientation.
LN255 is an affine-envelope relaxation and does not enforce LayerNorm radius or actual music-conditioned reachability.
PCA center uses all valid train-only tokens, but its covariance basis is a deterministic weighted-sample randomized approximation.
Teacher ground-truth token lengths are used only in this explicit oracle diagnostic, not in music student deployment.
RGB differences and sampled pose changes are not beat, dance-quality or generalization metrics.
